translation_notes: Runs against the REAL installed plastron-models 4.8.3 / plastron-utils (handles, models.*, rdfmapping.*, validation.*); original.py is unchanged. Nothing of the framework is re-implemented.

The 13 namespaces (`bibo dc dcmitype dcterms edm geo rel skos ore owl umd schema pcdm`) come in as prefixes: `from plastron.namespaces import bibo:, dc:, ...` and every `ns.term` (28 uses) becomes `ns:term` (`owl:sameAs`, `edm:Agent`, `dcterms:title`, ...). The raw `URIRef('http://id.loc.gov/datatypes/edtf')` datatype argument becomes `<http://id.loc.gov/datatypes/edtf>`.

`plastron.namespaces` defines the namespaces as plain `NAME = Namespace('...')` attributes under the prefixes' own names, which ldpy's `from … import p:` reads directly: the prefix import targets the installed package, with no shim.
`from rdflib import URIRef` is kept as is; it is no longer used in the translation (only the datatype argument used it).

Proof: the module defines classes and prints nothing, so run_pair(entry=None) finds nothing observable. driver.py is custom: it executes both artefacts and compares, for the six classes, the property table (attribute -> predicate, required, repeatable, datatype, embed, target class), the default rdf:type values, model_name/is_top_level/HEADER_MAP, and instances built through the descriptors (empty / complete / coerced-date / malformed-date Letter, Agent, Concept, Place, Collection, an embedded author): their graphs by isomorphism, and validate()/is_valid per property. The original shows a 20-triple letter graph, validation failures for the empty letter and for the malformed date. Break checks: `dcterms:title` -> `dc:title` FAIL; datatype IRI changed FAIL; `@rdf_type(edm:Agent)` -> `edm:Place` FAIL; restored OK.

validation.method: custom: property tables, defaults, built instances (isomorphism), validation reports

optimization_notes: optimized.py: the region is declarative (six classes of descriptor declarations and a HEADER_MAP); the only compression is formatting the three single-entry nested dicts of HEADER_MAP on one line (`'subject': {'label': 'Subject'},`, without the magic trailing comma). Nothing else to compress: every line declares a distinct property.

optimized.ldpy, from optimized.py: prefix import and prefixed names as in the translation, `<http://id.loc.gov/datatypes/edtf>` for the datatype; `from rdflib import URIRef`, a line of the region (which spans the whole module) no longer used once the IRI is an island, is dropped. No exception to the symmetry rule.
The driver emits through harness._emit and honours RDFEVAL_SIDES: rdfeval check proves every artefact.
